generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A result publisher and terminal guard fail to distinguish an existing historical blob, a path proven absent in the exact material tree, and an unavailable or failed observation. Testing only a light first-delivery fixture misses the cumulative-ledger requirements of a critical re-audit.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Treat a missing snapshot as proof of absence, fabricate an empty historical ledger, consult the later child HEAD instead of the material commit, or accept mutable snapshot bytes without comparison to the Git object.
trigger_signals: first creation of a cumulative ledger

reusable_control.procedure: Inspect the exact material Git tree with replacement objects disabled; authenticate existing snapshots against immutable blob bytes or record absence only after a successful path lookup. Run current-artifact semantic and historical lineage guards before and after publication.

generalized_learning.prevention_rule: A present material blob requires an identical snapshot. Proven absence requires a successful lookup of the exact material commit and safe path types. Unavailable objects, read errors, unsafe paths and inconsistent snapshots remain blocking. External rejection snapshots remain separate and mandatory when applicable.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Exercise critical targeted re-audit publication with real Git and both terminal guards, then reject forged absence, omitted or changed snapshots, symlinks, missing objects and observation of the later child in place of the material parent.

transfer_cases.procedure: Run the complete synthetic critical re-audit publication with external rejection snapshots and no versioned audit subtree in the material parent.
transfer_cases.expected: The real guards accept Git-proven absence and retain external rejection history after the child is created.

transfer_cases.procedure: Supply altered snapshot bytes for a ledger whose original bytes exist in an immutable synthetic Git commit.
